ops.title: P1 vault node SHIPPED + green (2026-07-19): commit map + what remains
ops.body:
P1 of the vault migration (acct-12 plan `now-that-metal-is-tingly-planet.md`) is landed on main and green.

**Commits (on main, atop the concurrent session's hermes-container-native stack a4da1c3f):**
- `4f822c59` feat(imessage): host-side corten hardware-key extractor → yclaw keychain (P0-e). CI green.
- `db177d46` feat(vault): the Linux 'vault' creds-custodian container node (the P1 body). **build-images CI green** (27-min hermes-image build + flake eval — the vault flake.nix additions are valid Nix). Its Guides check was red (transient, see below), now superseded.
- `2f4a1257` chore(pre-commit): ruff v0.8.6→v0.15.20 — REVERTED by `5720f58c` (my single-target `cc-guides render` corrupted the shared lock → Guides red on every push). Revert restored the consistent lock; main tip Guides **green**.

**Verified before ship:** pytest 355 green, ruff clean; codex refuter adversarially confirmed the critical secret-isolation redesign (secrets via `--env-file`, host-side decrypt, overlay DAC, unset-before-uid-1001-fork, provision argv window closed) empirically against the live apple/container runtime; 6 P1-blocking review findings fixed + verified; findings deferred to P3/P7/P1.5/docs are documented in note da891566.

**Net residual tooling debt (for the tooling owner, note b0307ec4):** stale ruff v0.8.6 pin (can't parse py314 → Python commits need --no-verify) + the cc-guides `.toml` capt-hook fragment render bug. Both blocked on each other.

**What remains in the migration:**
- P1.5 (re-scoped): the concurrent session already did the deploy/runtime side (retire tart-hermes runner, strip dead tart config from hermes.nix, tart→container repoint, docs). REMAINING = image-build consolidation: delete build-hermes-image.sh + build-images.yml (port its genericity guard into build-container-image.sh) + nixos/image.nix + scratch-login.nix + deploy-vm.sh + flake hermes-image/hermes-image-scratch/mkImage; rewire justfile/bootstrap/redeploy.
- P2: build + load the vault image on the builder VM (image MUST rebuild — the security redesign changed entrypoint + removed sops). build-container-image.sh not yet run end-to-end.
- P3+: bring-up (state COPY from live metal under quiesce, CA byte-equal, DIRECT-not-DERP, host reboot drill) → P4 flip (note b5c06535) → P5 soak → P6 park metal → G1/P7-P9 iMessage → P10 purge.
- User-interactive gates still open: run scripts/imsg-extract-key.sh in Terminal.app; approve cookiesync consent for the live ACL apply.
